structured.answer: Open a securities account at פסגות and buy ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D), the pair the page marks "★ הזול". The page says about 86,492 ₪ after 10 years, but that's for its own numbers (10,000 ₪ today plus 500 ₪ a month at 7%), not my 30,000.
